definitions.explanation: A traditional dance performed during the Obon festival in summer to honor the spirits of ancestors.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}になると{町|まち}で{盆踊|ぼんおど}りがある。
examples.english: There's a Bon dance in town when summer comes.

examples.japanese: {浴衣|ゆかた}を{着|き}て{盆踊|ぼんおど}りに{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I wore a yukata and participated in the Bon dance.

examples.japanese: {盆踊|ぼんおど}りの{輪|わ}に{加|くわ}わった。
examples.english: I joined the circle of the Bon dance.

notes:
TIMING:
{盆踊|ぼんおど}り is performed during {お盆|おぼん} (Obon), typically in mid-August (or mid-July in some regions).

STYLE:
Dancers form a circle around a raised platform ({櫓|やぐら}) and perform synchronized movements to traditional folk songs. Each region has its own distinctive dance style.

FAMOUS DANCES:
- {阿波踊|あわおど}り (Tokushima)
- {郡上踊|ぐじょうおど}り (Gifu)
- {西馬音内盆踊|にしもないぼんおど}り (Akita)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}りを{踊|おど}る: to dance the Bon dance
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り{大会|たいかい}: Bon dance festival
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}りの{曲|きょく}: Bon dance music
